name: y-trix
description: Yjs binding for the Trix editor (prototype)

scripts.build:demo: esbuild demo/main.js --bundle --format=esm --outdir=demo/dist && esbuild demo/main.js --bundle --format=esm --alias:trix=trix-2.0.10 --outfile=demo/dist/main-2.0.10.js && esbuild demo/main.js --bundle --format=esm --alias:trix=trix-2.0.0 --outfile=demo/dist/main-2.0.0.js
scripts.test: node tests/diff.unit.mjs && npm run build:demo && playwright test
